Mr. Yogesh Kumar Pacholia and Mr. 
Sagar Malara, learned counsel for 
petitioners.
2. Mr. Maneesh Bisht, learned Brief 
Holder for the State of Uttarakhand/ 
respondent Nos.1 to 3.
3. Petitioners are challenging the order 
dated 24.07.2026 passed by respondent 
No.4, whereby, representation submitted 
by petitioners, pursuant to direction 
issued by this Court, was rejected. 
4. Learned counsel for petitioners 
contends that petitioners are working as 
daily wager from outsourcing agency 
since 2004-2006, which is mentioned in 
Para 5 of the writ petition. Petitioners 
made representation for their 
regularization, but the same was 
rejected vide impugned order dated 
24.07.2026 passed by respondent No.4 
in highly arbitrary and illegal manner 
without considering the length of service 
of petitioners against their post. 
5. Issue notice to respondent No.4  returnable within four weeks.
6. Steps to be taken within a week.
7. Respondents may file counter 
affidavit(s) within four weeks.
8. Put up on 25.11.2026.
9. It is provided that since petitioners 
have put in substantially long service 
with respondent-department and are 
being paid salary of ₹11,000/- per 
month, respondent No.4 shall pay 
minimum of pay scale of regular Group￾D employees to petitioners during the 
pendency of present writ petition.
10. Stay application (IA/1/2026) stands 
disposed of.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 11.09.2026
R.Bisht/PN
